name: preview_page
description: Publish an interactive HTML page (a mockup, comparison, prototype, dashboard or report) to a private link on the user's own site, like Claude's artifacts: only the user can open it until he shares it from the page, and his notes on it come back to you. Use it whenever a page would show work better than text; no need to ask first. Call action guide before writing a new page. publish: path (an HTML file in the working folder; the files it links to in its folder go with it), title (two to four words), description (one sentence), link (an earlier page to update; publishing the same file again from this chat updates it too). list: the user's pages. read: a page's published HTML (link). delete: link; the user confirms.

path.description: publish: the HTML file, relative to the working folder

title.description: publish: a short name, two to four words

link.description: The page's link, to update (publish), read or delete it
